claims.claim: On October 9, 2026, Devasish Sharma of the BJP led Mohammed Badruddin Ajmal of the AIUDF by 63,701 votes in Assam’s Nagaon Lok Sabha bypoll, with Congress candidate Sibamoni Bora third.
claims.episode_span: led AIUDF’s Mohammed Badruddin Ajmal by 63,701 votes in Nagaon
claims.source_title: Bypoll results LIVE: BJP widens lead in West Bengal; TVK leads in Tamil Nadu
claims.supporting_quote: Devasish Sharma of BJP extends his lead over nearest rival Mohammed Badruddin Ajmal of AIUDF by 63,701 votes. Congress candidate Sibamoni Bora stands third.

claims.claim: After the ninth round in Dharapuram, P. Sathyabama of TVK had 24,047 votes, K. Bhanumathi of AIADMK 21,935, S. Suganya of DMK 19,972, M. Karthika of NTK 1,891 and P. Lakshmanan of CPI 442.
claims.episode_span: the ninth round had TVK’s P. Sathyabama on 24,047
claims.source_title: Bypoll results LIVE: BJP widens lead in West Bengal; TVK leads in Tamil Nadu
claims.supporting_quote: In Tamil Nadu’s Dharapuram (SC) constituency - Ninth round P. Sathyabama (TVK) - 24,047 K. Bhanumathi (AIADMK) - 21,935 S. Suganya (DMK) - 19,972 M. Karthika (NTK) - 1,891 P. Lakshmanan (CPI) - 442

claims.claim: Ashok Anand of the ruling AINRC held a clear and consistent lead in Puducherry’s Thattanchavady bypoll.
claims.episode_span: ruling AINRC candidate Ashok Anand held a clear, consistent lead
claims.source_title: Bypoll results LIVE: BJP widens lead in West Bengal; TVK leads in Tamil Nadu
claims.supporting_quote: With Ashok Anand, the bypoll candiate of the ruling AINRC taking a clear and consistent lead at Thattanchavady in the Union Territory of Puducherry, party workers celebrate on Friday.

claims.claim: West Bengal bypoll counting started at 8 a.m. on October 9, 2026, and the BJP holds 207 of 294 Assembly seats, so these results will not change the government.
claims.episode_span: counting in Nandigram and Rejinagar started at 8 a.m.
claims.source_title: Counting begins for Bengal bypolls, BJP's first electoral test after coming to power
claims.supporting_quote: Counting of votes began at 8 a.m. on Friday (October 9, 2026) for the Nandigram and Rejinagar Assembly bypolls , the first electoral test for the BJP since it came to power in West Bengal in May this year.

claims.claim: Nandigram recorded 80.89 percent turnout and Rejinagar 80.08 percent; the Election Commission called polling more or less peaceful, opposition parties demanded fresh polling, and the BJP rejected the allegations.
claims.episode_span: Tuesday’s turnout was 80.89 percent in Nandigram and 80.08 percent in Rejinagar
claims.source_title: Counting begins for Bengal bypolls, BJP's first electoral test after coming to power
claims.supporting_quote: The two constituencies witnessed a high turnout of around 80% on Tuesday (October 6, 2026), with Nandigram recording 80.89% polling and Rejinagar 80.08%.

claims.claim: The Fair Work Commission ruled Charles Graham was unfairly dismissed by HIFX Australia, trading as Xe, and did not award compensation.
claims.episode_span: Charles Graham was unfairly dismissed in December last year by HIFX Australia
claims.source_title: Sydney trader sacked for working from Singapore without permission wins unfair dismissal case
claims.supporting_quote: The Fair Work Commission ruled on Wednesday that Charles Graham had been unfairly dismissed by HIFX Australia, trading as Xe, in December last year.

claims.claim: The Australian consulate in Vietnam is seeking access to a Melbourne anti-trafficking activist held on terror charges that his family says are fabricated.
claims.episode_span: The Australian consulate in Vietnam is seeking access to him.
claims.source_title: Missing Melbourne man held in Vietnam on terror charges
claims.supporting_quote: The Australian consulate in Vietnam is seeking access to a Melbourne anti-trafficking activist on charges his family claims are fabricated.

claims.claim: Four CRPF personnel, two seriously, were injured in an accidental blast during explosives disposal near the Elarmadgu camp in Sukma.
claims.episode_span: Four CRPF personnel, two of them seriously, were injured on Thursday evening
claims.source_title: Four CRPF personnel injured in blast during explosives disposal in Sukma
claims.supporting_quote: Four Central Reserve Police Force (CRPF) personnel were injured, two of them seriously, in an accidental blast during the disposal of unserviceable and leftover explosives in Chhattisgarh’s Sukma district, police said.

claims.claim: Security forces neutralised 27 IEDs along an 8-kilometre stretch in Manipur’s Kamjong days after four Tangkhul Naga civilians were killed near Pilong.
claims.source_title: Security forces unearth 27 IEDs along 8-km stretch in Manipur’s Kamjong
claims.supporting_quote: Assam Rifles and Indian Army bomb disposal teams neutralised the devices found along the Shangkhalok-Pilong route, days after four Tangkhul Naga civilians were killed near Pilong village

claims.claim: New Zealand’s national censor said on Friday it could not block a planned livestreamed U.S. execution of a former Army major.
claims.episode_span: unable to block a planned livestreamed execution in the United States
claims.source_title: New Zealand censor says it would be powerless to block livestreamed US execution
claims.supporting_quote: New Zealand's national censor said on Friday it would be unable to block the planned livestreamed execution of a former Army major in the United States, as rights groups pressed governments to protest the decision with Washington.

claims.claim: The NIS said it was excluded from a June trilateral meeting on North Korean cyber threats, and some have urged sending Wi Sung-lac to Washington while a ruling-bloc official said there appear to be no such plans.
claims.episode_span: excluded from a June meeting with the United States and Japan
claims.source_title: Spy agency snub raises U.S. alliance concerns in S. Korea
claims.supporting_quote: The National Intelligence Service (NIS) on Thursday acknowledged that it had been excluded from the June meeting on North Korean cyber threats, after a news report said the agency had been left out at Washington's request.

claims.claim: New climate pledges brought Pacific Resilience Facility commitments to US$190 million, including Fiji’s US$10 million, Denmark’s US$2.3 million and the Netherlands’ US$1 million.
claims.episode_span: lifted commitments to the Pacific Resilience Facility to US$190 million
claims.source_title: Forum SG Waqa welcomes US$13.3m in new Pacific climate finance pledges ahead of COP31
claims.supporting_quote: The latest pledges bring total commitments to the PRF to US$190 million, following Fiji’s US$10 million contribution announced by Prime Minister Sitiveni Rabuka during the Pacific Pre-COP31 in Nadi.
